en.askTitle: Swap in your own school, budget and priorities to get the same checked-price laptop comparison
en.runTitle: A US computer-science freshman, a $1,300 budget: Mac and Windows laptops compared on real retailer pages

fields.label: Purchase deadline
fields.value: within the next couple of months

fields.label: Whether the budget includes tax, shipping, accessories and warranty
fields.placeholder: e.g. including tax and shipping, no accessories

fields.label: Enrollment status and discount eligibility
fields.placeholder: e.g. admitted, enrollment deposit paid, student ID not yet issued

fields.label: Is refurbished or open-box acceptable?
fields.placeholder: e.g. refurbished from the manufacturer is fine, open-box is not

fields.label: Official course requirements, software versions and VM-image architecture
fields.placeholder: e.g. department asks for 16 GB of memory and x86 virtual machine images

fields.label: Daily workload: tools, tabs, virtual machines and editing
fields.value: some video editing as a hobby

fields.label: What you care about most
fields.value: battery life, a decent screen, light enough to carry around campus, lasting 4 years

en.template: Help me choose a laptop in {place} by {when} for {school}. My budget is {budget}, {taxIncl} tax, shipping, accessories and warranty; my enrollment and discount eligibility are {eligibility}, and refurbished/open-box is {refurb}. Use {requirements}, {workload} and my priorities {priorities}. Compare buyable options and their full costs, check compatibility and flag what I should confirm before paying.

phases.title: Check live prices, student discounts and reviews on real retailer pages
phases.note: Mac, Windows x86 and Windows ARM options, with the school’s own laptop guidance
phases.judgment: It corrected the student discount before it reached you: Apple’s current education price for the exact 13-inch Air is $1,199, not the older $999 figure, and a student who has not yet been accepted or enrolled does not qualify just by planning to start in fall 2027.

phases.title: Weigh the options and build the comparison page and spreadsheet
phases.note: Shortlist of three, with the models to avoid
phases.judgment: A separate reviewer re-opened the key retailer pages and confirmed the $1,199 and $1,269 offers. It could not reproduce one owner-review story in its own sample and asked for the tax caveat to appear earlier, while finding nothing that changed the ranking.

phases.title: Check the files and save them to your folder
phases.judgment: It flagged what could break the budget: if your $1,300 includes tax, the near-cap Macs may exceed it, and if you do not need the laptop right away it suggests waiting until closer to summer 2027.

workers: Checked Mac prices, configurations and stock at Apple and other retailers, plus whether a future student qualifies for the education price
Checked Windows 14-inch laptops with Intel and AMD chips at US retailers: exact configurations, price and availability
Checked up to two Windows laptops with Arm chips, such as Surface Laptop and Zenbook A14, for price, specs and owner feedback
Independently re-read the findings and re-opened key retailer pages to look for contradictions and claims that were not backed up

chipNames.https://www.compreq.vt.edu/specs/compute: Virginia Tech computer science laptop requirements
chipNames.https://cse.umn.edu/college/future-stude: University of Minnesota laptop advice for CS students
chipNames.https://www.rtings.com/laptop/reviews/ap: RTINGS review of the 13-inch MacBook Air (M5)

zh.askTitle: 换成你自己的学校、预算和需求，得到同样核对过价格的笔记本对比
zh.runTitle: 美国计算机专业新生，预算 1,300 美元：在真实零售页上比较 Mac 和 Windows 笔记本

fields.label: 大学、专业和入学日期
fields.value: 计算机专业，2027 年秋季入学

fields.label: 预算是否包含税、运费、配件和保修
fields.placeholder: 例如：含税和运费，不含配件

fields.label: 录取或在读状态，以及优惠资格
fields.placeholder: 例如：已被录取、已交押金，学生证还没发

fields.label: 能否接受翻新或开箱机
fields.placeholder: 例如：官方翻新可以，开箱机不行

fields.label: 院系官方要求、软件版本和虚拟机镜像架构
fields.placeholder: 例如：院系要求 16GB 内存、x86 虚拟机镜像

fields.label: 日常使用：开多少软件和标签页、虚拟机、剪辑
最看重的方面
fields.value: 续航、屏幕够好、方便在校园带着走、能用满 4 年

zh.template: 请帮我在{place}、{when}前选电脑，用于{school}。预算{budget}，{taxIncl}税、运费、配件和保修；录取或在读及优惠资格是{eligibility}，翻新或开箱机{refurb}。请按{requirements}、{workload}，以及我看重的{priorities}比较可买选项，算清总费用，检查兼容性，告诉我付钱前还要确认什么。

phases.title: 在真实零售页核对现价、学生优惠和评测
phases.note: Mac、Windows x86 和 Windows ARM 三类选项，另看学校自己的选机建议
phases.judgment: 它在结论交给你之前纠正了学生优惠：苹果这款 13 英寸 Air 现在的教育优惠价是 1,199 美元，不是早先的 999 美元；还没被录取或注册的学生，不能只凭计划 2027 年秋季入学就享受优惠。

phases.title: 权衡选项，生成对比网页和表格
phases.note: 三款入围机型，外加建议避开的机型
phases.judgment: 一位独立复核的同事重新打开了关键零售页，确认 1,199 美元和 1,269 美元两个报价属实；它在自己的抽样里没能复现其中一条用户评价，也建议把税费提示提前，但没发现会改变排序的问题。

phases.title: 检查文件，存到你指定的文件夹
phases.judgment: 它指出了可能让预算失守的地方：如果你的 1,300 美元含税，接近上限的 Mac 可能超支；如果不急着用，建议等到更接近 2027 年夏天再买。

workers: 核对苹果和其他零售商的 Mac 价格、配置和库存，并确认未入学的学生能否享受教育优惠
核对美国零售商的 Intel 和 AMD 平台 14 英寸 Windows 笔记本：具体配置、价格和是否有货
核对至多两款 Arm 芯片的 Windows 笔记本（如 Surface Laptop、Zenbook A14）的价格、规格和用户反馈
独立重读前面的调研结果，并重新打开关键零售页，找出互相矛盾或缺乏依据的说法
